page.overview:
What is Utan Sonar?

Utan Sonar is the Shoujou Pirates' ship and one of the vessels of the Saruyama Alliance.

Utan Shonar is a wide-hulled ship, with giant trees serving as its masts. It has an orangutan face-shaped figurehead. In addition, the sides of the ship have many doors with ladders that lead to the water to aid the Utan Divers in their work monitoring sonar reverberations. The vessel also has two large paddles, one on each side of the ship, that hold the special chambers where the Utan Divers actually work.

Utan Sonar was sailing through the Mouth Bay of Jaya when it stopped to dive, activating the Utan Divers' Search Sonar. Once the divers detected a nearby vessel, Shoujou directed his and his crew's attention to the Going Merry. When Shoujou attacked the Straw Hat Pirates with his Havoc Sonar, his crew tried to stop him, as his own attack was damaging Utan Sonar.

Utan Sonar was docked on the shore of Mont Blanc Cricket's hideout until it and Victory Hunter escorted the Going Merry to the Knock Up Stream. As the Imperial Cumulus approached, the Utan Divers detected a giant current and whirlpool, and the ship was shaken by the rising waves. Utan Sonar stayed back, outside of the current of the whirlpool, and watched as the Blackbeard Pirates approached the Straw Hats. The ship was rocked when the Knock Up Stream erupted and launched the Going Merry into the sky.
